title: Aliquot
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Configure aliquoting for up to 96 tubes
steps.instruction: Enter the desired aliquoting parameters (e.g., source volume, destination wells) in the protocol interface; the protocol will aliquot flexibly into up to 96 Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files for the 96‑tube snap‑cap rack.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware (labware, tip rack, pipette) exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine for all labware, the tip rack, and the pipette, following the support article instructions.

steps.title: Run the aliquoting protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the flexible aliquoting into up to 96 Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes.
